item: The style non-growth ratchet ceiling drops from 417 to 414 (zero slack on main 7033552e7)
summary: scripts/ruff_ratchet.py, run at the old ceiling on main 7033552e7, printed that it can be lowered to 414; the ci.yml step now says --max 414. CI measures the MERGE, so a finding another PR lands first reddens whichever PR merges second; lanes whose pre-push still says 417 should use 414. The only other 417 in the tree is a fixture argv in tests/test_ruff_ratchet.py (the test where ruff is unrunnable and findings are patched out), not a second copy of the ceiling.
